pages.title: Your Origin
pages.text: $(thing)IridescentCraft$() features 13 unique origins, each with distinct powers and tradeoffs. Key principles:$(br2)$(item)No origin blocks any food type$() — dietary traits are preferences, not restrictions.$(br2)$(item)Environmental effects cause discomfort$(), not death.$(br2)$(item)Phantoms never truly die$() — they enter Spectral Collapse instead.

pages.title: Origins (1/3)
pages.text: $(bold)Arachnid$() — Scale walls, spin webs. Meat preference.$(br2)$(bold)Avian$() — Sky Affinity grants speed and agility at high altitudes. Plant preference.$(br2)$(bold)Blazeborn$() — Fire/lava immune. Nether Affinity boosts damage. Water slows you.$(br2)$(bold)Enderian$() — Teleport on cooldown. Ender Shift: +15% damage for 10s after teleporting. Water drains strength.$(br2)$(bold)Elytrian$() — Elytra flight + launch ability. The only origin with true flight.

pages.title: Origins (2/3)
pages.text: $(bold)Feline$() — Silent, always land on feet. Night vision. -20% HP.$(br2)$(bold)Merling$() — Breathe underwater. Sluggish after 5 min on dry land.$(br2)$(bold)Phantom$() — Phase through blocks. Half health. $(warn)Never truly dies$() — Spectral Collapse instead (5 min debuff).$(br2)$(bold)Shulk$() — Natural armor, equipment death protection, +20% mining speed. Heavy metabolism.

pages.title: Origins (3/3)
pages.text: $(bold)Witch of Ink$() — Passive hyperscaler. -20% HP, half food, fire weakness. Boss kills raise your TOTAL damage (melee + magic); 200 kills unlock Blessing of Penthesilea. $(thing)/icraft witch_status$()$(br2)$(bold)Artificial Construct$() — Iron golem. Eat iron for food + Regen III; a 5-level forge ladder + Iron Apotheosis capstone. $(thing)/icraft construct_status$()$(br2)$(bold)Witherborn$() — Undead DOT melee. Wither-on-hit, with a hunger-based damage tradeoff.$(br2)$(bold)Slimebodied$() — Food-management tank. Bonus food efficiency; satiety grants damage reduction.

pages.title: Witch of Ink — Tracker
pages.text: $(bold)Counter$() (max 200):$(br)  $(item)Apotheosis/Champions boss$() — +1$(br)  $(item)Dimensional boss$() — +10 (Wither, Dragon, Naga, Lich, etc.)$(br2)$(bold)Per counter:$()$(br)  +0.1% TOTAL damage dealt (cap +20%)$(br)  -0.1% incoming damage (cap -20%)$(br2)Run $(thing)/icraft witch_status$() to see your live counter, current bonuses, and capstone payout.

pages.title: Penthesilea Capstone
pages.text: At 200 counter, $(bold)Blessing of Penthesilea$() activates permanently:$(br2)$(item)+10%$() additive total damage (1.20 ladder + 0.10 = $(bold)1.30x$())$(br)$(item)+15%$() Spell Power → Attack Damage conversion$(br)$(item)+15%$() max HP$(br)$(item)Permanent:$() Haste I, Resistance I, Fire Resistance, Regeneration I$(br2)The damage buffs are $(bold)multiplicative on FINAL damage$() — they affect melee, ranged, and all magic spells (ISS + Ars).

pages.title: Construct — Tracker
pages.text: $(bold)Iron-consumed ladder$() (right-click iron ingot/block to eat):$(br)  L1 — 1000 iron — +5%$(br)  L2 — 2000 — +10% cum.$(br)  L3 — 4000 — +15% cum.$(br)  L4 — 8000 — +25% cum.$(br)  L5 — 16000 — $(bold)+35% cum.$()$(br2)Each level: MULTIPLY_BASE on HP + melee, ADD_VALUE × 4 on armor + toughness.$(br2)Run $(thing)/icraft construct_status$() for live state.

pages.title: Iron Apotheosis Capstone
pages.text: Reaching L5 unlocks $(bold)Iron Apotheosis$() permanently:$(br2)$(item)+25%$() max HP (on top of L5 → +60% total)$(br)$(item)+25%$() melee damage (→ +60% total)$(br)$(item)+1.0$() armor toughness (on top of L5 +1.4 → +2.4)$(br2)Iron-eating retains its Regen III for 10s on consume regardless of level.

pages.title: Best Combos
pages.text: $(bold)Blazeborn + Dwarf + Berserker$()$(br)Fire synergy. Nether becomes trivial.$(br2)$(bold)Elytrian + Elf + Ranger$()$(br)Maximum mobility. Fly, kite, never get hit.$(br2)$(bold)Enderian + Faefolk + Archmage$()$(br)Teleport, spell from range, glass nuke.$(br2)$(bold)Phantom + Any + Any$()$(br)Never die. Ever. 5 min penalty instead.$(br2)$(bold)Witch of Ink + Orc + Berserker$()$(br)Weak early, monster late. Hyperscaling melee.

pages.title: Design Notes
pages.text: $(bold)Origins are flavor.$() Your origin gives unique abilities. Your $(thing)Race$() gives stat modifiers. Your $(thing)Class$() gives combat role. All three stack.$(br2)$(bold)No combination is unplayable.$() Some are stronger than others, but the tradeoffs keep everything viable.$(br2)$(bold)Hyperscaling origins$() (Witch of Ink, Artificial Construct) are intentionally weak early. They reward 50-100+ hours of investment.
